# Pradeep Maurya

> I build modern, responsive, and scalable web applications that turn ideas into powerful digital experiences. From intuitive user interfaces to robust backend systems, I focus on clean code, practical problem-solving, and reliable software solutions. Based in Dehradun, India.

Portfolio site. Every page has a markdown twin at the same path with a
`.md` extension — the links below point straight at those. The site also
returns markdown to any request sending `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Core

- [Home](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/index.md): overview — stats, selected work, capabilities, credentials
- [About](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/about.md): background, full work history, certifications and education
- [Résumé](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/resume.md): complete CV — summary, experience, projects, skills, credentials
- [Skills](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/skills.md): technical skills grouped by where they sit in the stack
- [Contact](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/contact.md): email, phone, location, profiles

## Projects

- [ConsentX](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/work/consentx.md): A consent-focused digital solution designed to support consent management and privacy-related workflows. Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, REST APIs. (2026)
- [RegulatoryBridge](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/work/regulatorybridge.md): A regulatory-focused digital solution designed to organize compliance-related information and simplify regulatory workflows. Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, REST APIs. (2026)
- [Bakery](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/work/bakery.md): A complete bakery shop — storefront, cart and secure accounts, built end to end. Stack: Next.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redux Toolkit, JWT. (2025)
- [Xamlysis](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/work/xamlysis.md): An online examination portal — the kind of app where a bug has a deadline attached. Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, REST APIs, manual & API testing. (2025)
- [Movie Scraper](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/work/movie-scraper.md): A Django app that pulls movie data from several sources and refuses to trust any of them. Stack: Python, Django, data validation. (2025)
- [Portfolio](https://www.pradeepmaury.in/work/portfolio.md): A personal portfolio showcasing my technical expertise, selected projects, professional experience, and freelance development services. Stack: Python (static site generator), HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, GSAP, Lenis, Vercel serverless functions. (2026)
